# AutoDE skills

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:generate` from skills/, agents/ and skills/external.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every skill AutoDE has, the interview packs, and the vendor and community skills it works with. In a workspace, `autode skills list` (CLI), `autode_skills_list` (MCP) and the Skills view (VS Code) show the same catalog plus the team's own imported skills, and whether each external skill is installed on this machine.

## AutoDE skills

Named `autode-<scope>-<capability>` (scopes: `core`, `de`, `snowflake`, `databricks`, `oracle`, `dbt`). Each declares its stage kinds and platforms in its `metadata`; a stage gets the skills for its kind and the problem's target platform.

| Skill | Scope | Stage kinds | Platforms | Version | Maturity | Used by | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `autode-core-orchestrator` | core | — | any | 1 | tested | — | Run an AutoDE business problem's workflow in this host - find the next stage, have the right agent do it, hand it in, and tell the user what needs their approval. Use it when the user asks to work on, continue, or check progress of an AutoDE problem. |
| `autode-de-conformance` | de | conformance | any | 1 | tested | source-assessor | Check an AutoDE business problem's sources against the data contracts in its pack (catalog, samples and read-only live probes) and report every failure with what it breaks. Use it for the conformance stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-documentation` | de | document | any | 1 | tested | documenter | Document a business problem's data deliverables (design, data dictionary, operations runbook, decision log) from AutoDE's approved specification, workflow history, context and Pipeline Spec. Use it for the documentation stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-mapping` | de | mapping | any | 1 | tested | sttm-mapper | Write the source-to-target mapping of an AutoDE business problem - entity by entity and column by column, with transformations, using AutoDE's deterministic column matcher as evidence - into the problem's mapping document. Use it for the mapping stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-modelling` | de | modelling | any | 1 | tested | data-modeler | Design the target data model of an AutoDE business problem - entities, grain, keys, foreign keys and history - from AutoDE's deterministic draft, check it, and record the model, its DDL (rendered by AutoDE) and its rationale. Use it for the modelling stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-pipeline-build` | de | build | any | 1 | tested | pipeline-engineer | Build an AutoDE business problem's pipelines - a Pipeline Spec of transform primitives (staging, deduplication, incremental loads) drafted from the approved mapping, model and facts, compiled by AutoDE into code with grounding manifests. Use it for the build stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-quality-rules` | de | quality-rules | any | 1 | tested | quality-engineer | Define the data quality rules for an AutoDE business problem - not-null, uniqueness, accepted values, ranges, referential integrity, freshness and reconciliation tolerances - each traced to the specification, a contract or the data. Use it for the quality-rules stage of an AutoDE workflow. |
| `autode-de-source-assessment` | de | source-assessment | any | 3 | tested | source-assessor | Assess the source systems of an AutoDE business problem - bring their metadata into the estate, profile keys, grain, volumes and freshness with read-only aggregate queries, propose keys, grain and relationships as facts, and draft the source context. Use it for the source-assessment stage of an AutoDE workflow. |

## Interview packs

The requirements interview's parts (`skills/*.json`), offered over MCP as `autode_interview_<id>` prompts. They become `autode-de-*` skills when the business analyst moves to a role template.

| Pack | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `constraints-assumptions` | Surfaces technical, regulatory, and organisational constraints and records explicit assumptions. |
| `data-flow` | Maps the business data flows from source to target, including frequency and grain. |
| `quality-acceptance` | Defines data-quality expectations and verifiable acceptance criteria. |
| `requirements-discovery` | Elicits business requirements, measurable objectives, scope boundaries, and stakeholders from the business problem. |
| `source-catalog` | Identifies and characterizes the source systems, data stores, and their availability. |
| `synthesis` | Assembles the collected requirements into a comprehensive, structured Business Problem Specification. |
| `transformations` | Captures the business transformation rules applied between source and target. |

## External skills (references only)

Skills from vendors and the community that AutoDE works with. AutoDE does not copy or ship them: their licences are below. When one is installed in a host, AutoDE names it in the assignments of the stages it helps with. When it isn't, AutoDE can offer the vendor's own install command (probed first, run only on a click). Correct or add entries in `.autode/config/external-skills.yaml`.

### Installing

- **Databricks agent skills:** `databricks aitools install` (needs databricks 1.0.0+); last verified 2026-10-22 (against the vendor's README (the command was not run by AutoDE's CI yet)). Vendor docs: https://github.com/databricks/databricks-agent-skills.
  - claude: In Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add databricks/databricks-agent-skills, then /plugin install databricks@databricks-agent-skills
  - copilot: copilot plugin marketplace add databricks/databricks-agent-skills, then copilot plugin install databricks@databricks-agent-skills

### Licences

- **Databricks License** ([text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/databricks/databricks-agent-skills/main/LICENSE)): Use only in connection with Databricks Services; modified files must say so; Databricks may end the licence on notice, after which copies must be deleted. AutoDE references these skills and never ships them.
- **Part of Snowflake Cortex Code** ([text](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/snowflake-coco/)): Built into Cortex Code and available only inside it.
- **Per skill (Apache-2.0 for community contributions, a Snowflake licence for Snowflake employees' contributions)** ([text](https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/coco-skills)): Each skill carries its own LICENSE file; check it before importing. Snowflake does not guarantee these skills' correctness.
